newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro buys plot worth 2.311 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Metro buys plot worth 2.311 bln pesos.

text.p: Metro Pacific Corp, the flagship company of First Pacific Co Ltd of Hong Kong, had bought a 10,668 square metre property inside Fort Bonifacio at 2.311 billion pesos, Metro finance director Christopher Young said on Tuesday.
Young said the company bought the lot from Fort Bonifacio Development Corp, a joint venture between a 17-company consortium and a state agency. The consortium is led by Metro Pacific.
The company plans to construct a luxury condominium project inside Fort Bonifacio, an emerging business district at the edge of the Makati financial area.
Metro Pacific will pay 5.0 percent of the contract amount on the date of the signing, while the balance is payable over three to five years, Young said.
The contract signing date was not dislosed.
